weather_summary: Sunny and hot around the mid-to-upper 90s; prioritize morning outdoor plans and indoor afternoon backups

events.title: 80th Annual Japanese Food & Cultural Bazaar
events.label: Best festival
events.food: Teriyaki chicken, beef teriyaki sandwiches, udon, sushi, gyoza, poke, sweets, matcha, and festival drinks
events.why: The strongest weekend match: major cultural festival, substantial food options, kids games, live performances, and flexible drop-in timing. Go early for heat and crowd control.

events.title: Pop Into STEM at Sacramento Children's Museum
events.label: Best indoor
events.food: Rancho Cordova coffee and lunch nearby
events.why: Purpose-built for young kids and weather-proof. Hands-on STEM tables are a better toddler fit than most ticketed shows.

events.title: Midtown Second Saturday + Midtown Farmers Market
events.label: Art + market
events.time: Sat, Aug 8; market 8:00 AM-1:00 PM, arts all day
events.food: Midtown Farmers Market, coffee, pastries, and nearby restaurants
events.why: Good flexible Saturday plan: start with the market in the morning, add art/music only if energy holds, then exit before heat peaks.

events.title: River Fox Train Family Fun Day
events.label: Train day
events.time: Sun, Aug 9, noon departure listed by Sacramento365; verify ticket time
events.cost: Ticketed; one child rides free with each full-price adult per venue page
events.food: Picnic-style snacks and nearby West Sacramento food options
events.why: A memorable family outing for train-loving kids, but the midday timing and heat make it less nap-safe than morning options.

events.title: Sacramento Sunday Certified Farmers Market
events.label: Market snacks
events.food: Fruit, pastries, coffee, prepared foods, and samples when available
events.why: Low-commitment food walk with a clean morning window, strong snack value, and an easy exit before nap or heat.

events.title: Historic Folsom Farmers Market in the Plaza
events.label: 45-min market
events.food: Produce, baked goods, coffee, and prepared market food
events.why: Good 45-minute-radius market with a walkable old-town setting and enough food variety to feel like a small adventure.

events.title: High School Musical at Fair Oaks Performing Arts Center
events.label: Family show
events.time: Sat or Sun, Aug 8-9, 8:00 PM listed
events.place: Fair Oaks Performing Arts Center, Fair Oaks
events.why: A family-friendly title, but the late start makes it better for older kids or toddlers who can handle evening shows.

events.title: Fairytale Town morning visit
events.label: Toddler reliable
events.why: Reliable toddler fallback with small-child scale, easy stroller flow, and quick exits if heat or nap pressure hits.

events.title: SMUD Museum of Science and Curiosity
events.label: Heat backup
events.why: Strong hot-weather backup with interactive exhibits, bathrooms, stroller access, and food nearby.

events.title: Sacramento Public Library branch events backup
events.label: Free indoor
events.food: Pick a branch near coffee or lunch
events.why: Best no-cost indoor backup for heat, short attention spans, or a fragile nap day; verify the specific branch schedule first.

events.title: California State Railroad Museum + Old Sacramento food loop
events.label: Indoor anchor
events.food: Old Sacramento restaurants, treats, and coffee nearby
events.why: Big trains plus indoor cooling make this a durable backup when outdoor events feel too hot.

events.title: Davis Farmers Market morning trip
events.label: Davis market
events.food: Produce, baked goods, coffee, picnic snacks
events.why: Bigger market feel inside the wider radius, with lawn space and a strollerable park loop.

events.title: Sacramento Zoo daytime visit
events.label: Animal fallback
events.food: Zoo concessions and Land Park food nearby
events.why: Reliable toddler interest, but this weekend’s heat makes it an early-only plan.

events.title: Funderland Amusement Park
events.label: Tiny rides
events.why: A toddler-scale ride loop that can be kept short; go early and bail before peak heat.

events.title: Crocker Art Museum family stop
events.label: Quiet indoor
events.why: Calm indoor swap when energy is lower; best for families whose toddlers can handle a quiet museum loop.
